2. The instant application under Section 483 Cr.P.C./ 529 BNSS has been filed with the following prayer:-
"Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to direct to the concerned court for expeditious and proper disposal of Case No. 850/2023 arising out of F.I.R./Case Crime No. 0185/2022 Under Sections 498A,

3.

He urges that the interest of justice would be subserved if this Hon'ble Court is pleased enough to direct the Court below to conclude the proceedings of Case No. 850 of 2023 arising out of F.I.R./Case Crime No.
0185 of 2022 Under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Mawai, District - Faizabad within a stipulated period of time as may be fixed by this Court.
4. The counsel appearing for the State has no objection to the contention aforesaid.

5. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, the Trial Court is hereby directed to conclude the proceeding of Case No. 850 of 2023 arising out of F.I.R./Case Crime No.
0185 of 2022 Under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Mawai, District - Faizabad, in expedition, if there is no legal impediment, while considering the guidelines and circulars issued time to time in this regard.
6. The application is disposed off accordingly.
